subject: delta(client): WF pass the lane owner on every reuse and refuse invalid lane options
note: withOwnedOrAcquiredLane passes the lane owner to its work on every path: the newly acquired owner, or the reused lane's own owner, whether the lane is reused from the current async frame or through an explicit owner. A frame whose owner is no longer live refuses journal-fenced, and options that are not an object refuse journal-invalid. The README states that maxRecords and maxTotalBytes apply per namespace and that a failed unused-acquisition cleanup keeps the effect fence closed until a new fence is created. The commit recorded its change in the archive the package kept before the record files; this record states it in the record layout.
